scientific_integrity: Universal results follow from analytical basis-action, gamma-ratio and Calkin-spectrum arguments. Included finite Python checks are corroboration only. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are for monomial symbols of distinct nonnegative degrees and the explicitly defined unnormalized monomial-decimator on \(A^2_\alpha\) for real \(\alpha>-1\). The unweighted norm is determined; arbitrary-weight ordinary norms and general symbols are not classified. Full text of the 2010 predecessor was unavailable; no independent publication-priority review.
title: A \(k^2\)-residue transition for essential singular spectra of Bergman slant commutators
